title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 220 Elm Avenue in Munising, Michigan, as the "Elizabeth L. Kinnunen Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 220 Elm Avenue in Munising, Michigan, as the "Elizabeth L. Kinnunen Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names the Postal Service building at 220 Elm Avenue in Munising, Michigan, the "Elizabeth L. Kinnunen Post Office Building."
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific post office in Munising, Michigan an official name honoring Elizabeth L. Kinnunen. It only changes the building's designation. It does not change how mail is handled, what services the office offers, or who works there.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014, and the naming took effect on that date.
